value: shut
In the opened state the house is open. In the opened state the arrangement is over.
boom open
In the shut state the boom is closed. The horn sounds unanswered.
slot open
In the silting state the slot is a tighter squeeze. In the silting state the sump is longer.
buried
In the opened state the four villages' arrangement has ended.
In the watched state the hoist runs and a flag flies.
In the unwatched state a winged creature occupies the top cage.
In cutting season every shed is lit and grades are called all day.
In a seam scare the sheds sit idle and the grading hall is shut. The townsfolk argue.
In cutting season the site holds stacks, spades and strips.
In the underground-fire state smoke rises from a face that has no worker near it.
outside the boundary
In the surveyed-in state rent collectors walk the ledges.
In the wet season the site is three tree stands and open water.
In the dry season the site is a herd ground. Four villages and their predators gather there.
In the open state, tokens hang on the rail.
In the closed state, the village has closed the wallow. The fence is down and the hut is shuttered.
stocked
In the stripped state, the cache is emptied. The tally board still shows stock.
rotation held
In the broken state, six boats work where two should. The crews ignore the notches.
fed (the wall settled)
In the hungry state, the birds have come down on the road.
In one state the trials are running. Pilgrims are camped and the stewards are occupied.
In one state the trials are closed. The xanmeer is shut and one steward sits on the step.
totem line intact
In one state a post shows signs of meddling. The basin goes quiet and a creature is out there.
In one state the hammock is dry. The soil is visible below the houses.
In one state the hammock is flooded. The graveyard is under water and the village asks for help.
In one state the room is let. The tenant is in residence.
In one state the room is given up. The tenant leaves an hour after the door was tried. Only a cold lamp and a good chair remain.
In the wet season the stair is drowned. In the wet season the cavern can only be dived.
In the dry season the first two chambers can be walked.
empty meadow
On naming-day, four villages gather under one tree. A registrar attends whom the villages did not invite.
In the wet season a single crossing is usable. The gate is full and the town is rich.
In the dry season eight fords are usable. The gate is empty and the town is idle.
nine as they stand
the ninth completed
bench working
In the idle state the wheel is stopped. A grading-house notice is nailed to the shed.
On a quiet night only the yard and the household are present.
In the full-yard state forty strangers share one fence and one door.
levy paid
If the levy is withheld, the lamp goes out. The door is shut for the first time.
full village
In the half-empty state, the houses are shuttered. The terraces are going back to grass.
four camps
In the strike state, three camps are abandoned overnight. One camp is crowded.
in tune (six chords)
In a hot year, two ponds have drifted. The farmer is not sleeping.
In the dry season the hamlet has six houses and empty yards.
In flood the hamlet is full and boats are tied to the eaves.
In the dry season the village is an ordinary village.
In flood the village rents out standing room. Its population is three times larger.
transferring (both banks working)
In spate, the river stops all movement for six weeks. The town fills with stuck cargo.
nesting (uninhabitable and loud)
Out of nesting, the stand is silent. The ground is workable.
decking sound
With a gap open, the crossing is a four-kilometre detour or a swim.
family in residence
In this variant the house is shut and the gaps are failing.
tended
The neglected state applies when a household refused its duty. The islanders answered the refusal.
hoist working
In the hoist-failed state the ladder is the sole working route. A queue forms at the ladder.
harvest (the yard full)
In the assessment variant the assessor's table stands in the yard. In that variant all the residents stay silent.
empty
In the filled variant the stone sits in the socket. In that variant the chamber works again.
open crossing
In the closed-crossing variant the pact of the Accord is failing. In that variant traffic backs up on both sides.
Out of season the flat is clean with a weir footing.
During the Feast, the flat holds fires and a crowd. The Feast lasts three days.
When the rise is dry the rope hangs slack. No crossing is made then.
When the rise floods the hamlet decamps to its rival. The rope is in use then.
In rotation the fence is up with the banners of one user.
When overstocked two users arrive at once. An argument breaks out at the water.
standing
The top of the tree has gone. The village has a problem that it refuses to name.
In one state the yard is working and the shed is lit.
In one state the yard is dark and has no stock. The boat channel is left without a landmark.
dark (the court working)
In one state a lamp stands on the ridge. The whole purpose of the court is then in question.
empty
In one state travellers occupy the chapel. Their identity is not yet known.
The survey pegs are visible in the dry season.
A kilometre of the cut lies under water in the wet season. The drainage is obvious.
In the active state, four cultists are aboard and the cellar is lit.
In the abandoned state, the cell has cleared out and burned the board. The shrine is left standing.
In the raided state, An-Xileel seals are on the door. One guard remains. The cellar is as found.
occupied
In the empty state, the cell is intact and the fuel cache is untouched.
Stocked state: the shelter holds fuel, a stove and a night's rest.
Stripped state: the shelter is a bare stone room. The traveller must decide whether to continue.
Drawdown state: the bar is exposed for four hours.
Covered state: the water is deep and the animals are up on the bar.
route as known
Hold-moved state: the hold has shifted and the last section is a genuine problem.
Sale day state: the floor is full, bidding runs and the watch is doubled.
Between-sales state: the lots are racked and four people are aboard.
as last recorded
Turned state: the disc has turned and the marker posts are wrong again.
Worm-at-home state: the worm is working beneath the ground.
Worm-out state: the tunnel is open and a decision is pending.
Accord-holding state: patrols are mixed. The ball court is in use.
Accord-broken state: two quarters are guarded. The square is empty.
Harvest state: every hand is in the fields. The floor is full.
Standing-water state: the boundary is invisible. The argument is academic.
lamp lit
Lamp-dark state: the arms cannot be found at night.
all four arms sound
One-arm-failed state: a village is cut off. The argument is about whose job the repair was.
waiting
Moved-on-the-ground state: the camp has crossed the bank. Everything has changed.
orderly (the board honoured)
Broken-order state: a pilgrim has jumped the queue. The pilgrims in the camp are deciding what to do about it.
Dry-season state: five tilted houses stand.
Wet-season state: three of the houses are under water. One house is still dry.
market-day
Closed-road state: one wedge of the square is empty. The other two wedges are doubled.

when: default
what_changes: The chamber is kept dark. The village is closed to visitors.

when: This state applies after the severance is proved.
what_changes: The chamber is opened. The log is made available.

when: The state applies after the closed council admits an outsider.
what_changes: The inner gallery becomes passable. The council chamber is lit.

when: The state applies while the main-quest withdrawal is active.
what_changes: The residents take down the chime lines. The lamps on the upper lanes go out. Traffic halts.

when: This state holds before the Eye opens the city.
what_changes: The underwater entry is closed. The terraces are unlit.

when: after MQ29 opens it
what_changes: The entry is passable. The cult occupation is live. The sanctuary is reachable.

when: This state applies before the cult is broken.
what_changes: The warren is lit and guarded. The cut pattern is being extended.

when: after
what_changes: The warren is dark. The cultists abandoned it in haste. Evidence is still in place.

when: The in-session state applies during Hist-Tsoko or a called convocation.
what_changes: In session the ring is full. In session the floor is lit. In session travel to the ground is busy.

when: out of season
what_changes: Out of season the worn floor is empty. One chime frame stands on the empty floor.

when: default
what_changes: In the sealed state, the stair-throat is shut. The hum is felt only outside.

when: This state applies after the chamber is opened.
what_changes: In the opened state, the living tree can be reached. Its sap-glow lights the interior.

value: In the gathering state the hall is full and a sermon is in progress. No weapons are drawn.
The blown state has six hostiles. The congregation is gone. The hall is as they left it.

when: default
what_changes: The making record in the basin is unread. The Warden is hostile to the visitor on meeting.

when: This state applies after the making record is understood.
what_changes: The Warden can be stood down at the Lost City. What is growing in the basin stays dormant.

when: default
what_changes: The station is roofless and unlit. The road head is silted.

when: This state applies if the station is claimed and held as a stronghold.
what_changes: The station is re-roofed and lit. The road head is cleared.

when: LF83 e-shared (stage 40)
what_changes: thing.lf83.well-head: a band of fresh grey clay pressed in behind the coping on the ford side
description: The landing has sealed the cracked well head with clay.

value: In a good week the yard is raked and the house is quiet.
In a bad week the yard is unraked. In a bad week the doors are barred from inside.
When empty, the fence is open and the hut is shuttered.
When in use, the fence is closed. The keeper sits out the night.
When the market is open, the board is full and three buyers are present.
In a glut, the board is blanked, the sheds overflow and tempers are short.
In the wet season the ditches are full and the banks are green.
In the dry season a herd stands in the cuts. In the dry season the profile is bare.
ladders down (day)
With the ladders drawn up, it is night. The crew stays on the water.
Manned state: the bell rings, the lamp burns and the lookout calls the lanes.
Unmanned state: something else occupies the top platform.
Wet season state: the cisterns are full and the terraces are green.
Dry season state: the cisterns are rationed and a guard watches them.
Out of season state: the ground holds post-holes and a stone.
Moonmarch state: an awning town stands there with three drums and a bell.
licence current
Licence lapsed state: the shutters are closed and the jars go cloudy.
Unlit state: the halls stand as the Orma left them.
Lit state: a scholars' camp lights the halls. The halls then become legible in the wrong way.
worked (hammer, three men)
Walked away from state: the tents stand, the pile is abandoned and the stake is still legible.
garrison at strength
In one state the garrison is drawn down. Half the billets are empty. The trade of the town falls with them.
In one state the kiln is cold. The den is open for business.
In the other state the kiln is fired. The den is closed. The room is in use for firing.
empty and cold
The storm-full state has three parties, one fire and no door.
In one state the charge is kept. The clay seams are fresh. The Sul-Xan stay at a distance.
In one state the charge is failing. A new crack has been unpacked. Raiders stand on the terrace.
route intact
In one state, a course has gone. The old route dead-ends. The visitor must find the new route.

description: The island core has changed hands; the gates are shut and the boardwalk city is trading around them.
Wet-season high water: the boardwalk city floats a metre higher and the lower gate is unusable.
Drawdown has put the crown within a metre of the surface and the whole district has come to see it.
The bricked stair is open; the yard has emptied and the families are camped on the causeway.
Blackrose is holding the causeway; nothing enters and the yard is rationing.
The screen route is compromised; the lagoon is empty and the rings have no rope on them.
Wet season: the water is a hand under the deck boards, the end ramps are steep and the low sections are planked over.
Dry season: the piles stand clear of the mud to knee height and the end ramps lie almost flat.
The Owing brokers have found it; the doors are shut and the tag wall is stripped.
Six weeks a year the bed is dry; people walk and trade across it.
Open water, nothing above the surface; the market is a dive site.
Drawdown puts the top terrace at two metres; every treasure-hunter in the basin is on it.
The village has stopped handling freight; a kilometre of loading deck stands empty and Blackrose is hurting.
Murkwood has moved: the verge is a kilometre away and the watch camp is standing in open marsh.
A cutting has been granted; the enclosure has something in it and the settlement's whole posture changes.
A flood has topped the levee for the first time in memory and the single street is a channel.
The seal is broken and the passage is draining into the prison's own water supply.
The Rose has been emptied; the town's whole economy is visibly ending.
The compact has lost the gates to the city; the boards read differently and the queue is longer.
Locals have finally driven the burial poles. Ranks of new poles break the grass pattern. A line of cairns runs along the ridge track.
Blackrose has enforced a toll here; half the sheds are shut and the trade has gone back to the city.
Lilmoth has dropped its tariffs and Meerhleel's quay is empty.
Fire has come back into the burn country and the fields are being cut as breaks.
A cutting has been planted in the enclosure and the recitation has stopped.
The sill has shifted and the marked mouth is now the false one.
The lantern is burning again and every hull on the bay approach is behaving differently.
The glow has failed for a season and the safe lanes cannot be read.
A deck has gone; the district's upper network is four dead ends.
The approach defences have been used; the causeway is scorched and the clan is not receiving.
The crews have stopped lightering; laden hulls are lying off Lilmoth doing nothing.
Council tariffs raised: Meerhleel and Moonmarch busy, Lilmoth quay half idle.
The third Hist has not spoken for a season; the council rules are suspended and the city is tense.
Wet-season peak: the lower walkways are closed and everything moves one tier up.
The council has taken the valuation book; the floor is empty and the stair is chained.
The flat is walkable and the whole village is out on it.
The water stands two metres over the flat. The village is reached only by boat. The villagers have stopped work.
The flat is walkable and the bells are ringing.
Sailable water; the withies lean and the bells are silent.
A thief has broken the taboo. The shelves are stripped. The district knows who did it.
The seal is broken; whatever was closed in is a district-wide problem.
One of the four claimants is briefly on top; the gates and the harbour office change hands with it.
A survey party is in town and the whole city is behaving as if the mines might reopen.
The poles have been driven again, but the figures do not keep the paths.
Somebody has bridged the gaps; the fastest route in the region exists again, for a season.
The ground has been struck and raked; there is nothing here at all.
The wet season has taken the pans; the bunds are gone and the works is under a metre of water.
The repatriation chain has finished here; the block is empty in a different way.
The rope ladder is up and the ledges are being worked in order.

when: This variant applies while a Death Hunt is running.
what_changes: The village is half-empty. The muster ground is struck.

when: otherwise
what_changes: The village is full. The drums answer. The landing is crowded.

when: default
what_changes: Shelters are sound. Stores are turned. Caretakers are in residence.

when: during a sheltering crisis
what_changes: The shelters are full. The stores are broken open. The memorial line is moved aside.

when: default
what_changes: The scaffold stands. The crew is present. The hum stutters.

when: This variant applies after the crew is driven off.
what_changes: The scaffold is down. The drums resume. The blue light steadies.

when: This state applies during the tree's two speaking hours.
what_changes: The whole village is present and silent. Villagers ask outsiders to wait outside the ring.

when: This state applies for the rest of the day.
what_changes: Village life is normal. The tree-minder will talk.

when: default
what_changes: The ring is maintained. The village is quiet by day.

when: This variant applies if the ring is broken.
what_changes: The walkers range beyond the pikes. The nearest camps strike.

value: In the neutral state the price list is up. Both halls are open. No flag flies.
In the leaned-on state one flag flies. The price list is painted out. The halls are shut.
In the staged state the racks are full. The destinations are two weeks out. The carriers are waiting.
In the stalled state the racks are full. The carriers are not carrying because the next leg has refused the bundles.
In the dry season the flood gate is open. The hamlet trades downstream.
In the flood the gate is shut. Each household carries its one expensive object upstairs.
In the waiting state the planting circle is swept. The argument is unresolved.
In the planted state something is in the circle. Half the camp will not look at it.
In the derelict state the ramp is rotting. The rails have been robbed for timber.
In the in-use state the ramp is regraded. The rails are sound. People in Corimont do not say so.
In the orderly state, the roll is read and the shift goes out.
In the attacked state, fire burns on the deck and the courier is down. The cell is already leaving.
In the aftermath state, the barge lists at its mooring. The barge is left without an overseer.
In the orderly state, the shed is lit and the walkways are swept. The roll is read on the barge.
In the attacked state, the gang has gone to the barge. The families defend their doors.
In the aftermath state, the shed stands open and the lamp is out. Dead eggs lie in the nest. Two cairns stand on the bluff top.
When the pass is open, the season board is green. The keeper is bored.
When the pass is shut, the board is closed. People in the queue wait for the pass to open.
In the unclaimed state the landing is silting. In the unclaimed state the mooring rings are green.
In the claimed state the landing is dredged. In the claimed state a claimant's mark is on the gate.
In the tariffed state the board prices coin, goods and obligation. In the tariffed state the span is kept.
In the free state the board is painted out. In the free state the span is left unrepaired.
In the speaking state the tree chimes. In the speaking state the hatchery is lit. In the speaking state minders stand on the landing.
In the withdrawn state there are no chimes. In the withdrawn state the pool is covered. In the withdrawn state the village stays indoors.
In the harbour-open state customs is staffed. In the harbour-open state the boom is down. In the harbour-open state three currencies are on the board.
In the harbour-shut state the boom is up. In the harbour-shut state the bonded row is sealed. In the harbour-shut state the tide streets carry the trade.
In the reachable state, the low branch is within an adult's arm. In that state the harbour treats the Hist as furniture.
In the raised state, the branch is cut or grown out of reach. In that state the harbour argues about whose tree it is.
In the closed state, the 4E 187 order is still nailed up. In that state the sanctuary is empty inside.
In the answering state, the order is gone. In that state one lamp is lit. In that state a name is expected.
In the quiet state the niches are empty. In the quiet state a house mark stays unclaimed.
In the claimed state an unnamed party has begun filling the niches. The work is not Velothi.
Running state: a departure is carved on the board and the hole is warm.
Stopped state: the boarding stage is barred and the hole is cold.
In the state 'air held', the ceiling pockets are breathable. In that state the corner is standing.
In the state 'air lost', a settle has vented the chambers. In that state the dive takes one breath.
In the state where the stair is kept, the hauling gear is rigged. In that state the bench is lit.
In the state where the stair is cut, the village is provisioned from the water only.
In the navigable state, this season's limit board is painted high.
In the unrunnable state, the board is painted low. The porters' rates are doubled. The reach is jammed.
The state is open. The board is chalked before dawn. The flat is walkable for two hours.
The state is shut. The board is not chalked. Whoever went out on yesterday's timing is still out there.
In the kept state, the mound is edged. The offerings are fresh.
In the argued state, a second mound is started beside the first. People who count the year differently start it.
